actor.name: Adam Pleskot (original identity holder)
actor.description: The original Adam Pleskot was nineteen years old and had been educated in Birmingham, where he lived with his Polish parents. His parents moved to the United Kingdom in December 1939 during World War II. Adam had graduated from high school. He and both parents died when their car fell off a cliff during a trip to Great Orme.

actor.name: AION Software
actor.description: British software company continuing CAP after Adam Pleskot acquires a controlling interest and the company adopts the AION Software name. Headquarters and established contract teams remain in CAP’s London offices. Alex d’Agapeyeff leads the company as CEO; its dedicated product programme works with AION Labs in Cambridge, Logix and independent software partners.

actor.name: Structured Systems Group
actor.description: Independent software publisher in Oakland, California. Owns General Ledger, its CBASIC original and the AION C adaptations; maintains its own management, licensing, customer relationships and application support.

actor.name: Gordon Letwin
actor.description: London-based AION Software systems-software director and technical liaison to DRI, with a service-based equity grant. He remains in London when the AIONix team relocates to California.

actor.name: First National City Bank

actor.name: Alex d’Agapeyeff
actor.description: CAP co-founder and software-industry leader retained as CEO and director when CAP becomes AION Software. He leads customer work and product initiatives within board-approved budgets. His personal holding is part of the former CAP shareholder block; its allocation is not specified.

actor.name: CAP existing shareholders
actor.description: Registered CAP shareholders participating in the investment and share-sale agreement, including Alex d’Agapeyeff to the extent of his verified holding.
